name: AgentBoard
description: An analytical evaluation board for multi-turn LLM agents across 9 diverse tasks in partially observable environments including household manipulation, tool use, database querying, web navigation, and game playing. Provides fine-grained analytical metrics beyond final success rate: grounding accuracy, world model accuracy, and self-reflection capability.
evaluation_method: task success rate; fine-grained metrics (grounding, world modeling, self-reflection accuracy)
general_score_metric: task success rate + progress rate (partial credit for multi-step completion)
typical_sota_score: ~30–50% task success rate (frontier models; varies widely by environment)
reputation: Published at NeurIPS 2024; open-source toolkit with comprehensive analytical dashboard; used to evaluate GPT-4, Llama-3, DeepSeek, and other major models; provides diagnostic multi-dimensional analysis
notes: NeurIPS 2024. Key innovation: progress rate metric gives partial credit for multi-step tasks, providing more nuanced signal than binary success. Fine-grained analysis identifies that models fail differently across grounding (understanding environment state), world modeling (predicting action outcomes), and self-reflection (recovering from errors). 9 environments: ALFWorld, WebShop, InterCode-SQL, SciWorld, BabyAI, TextCraft, WEATHER, MOVIE, TODOList.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
